description: T3 culture pool. Category pool (21 Wikipedia category roots, depth 3; eligible = film, TV film, serial, novel or short story with >= 8 plot sentences, not in DEV) minus the vigilante-only works except a 400-work hash subsample (sha256('phylomemetics-T3-vigilante-v1|' + title)), plus 1,000 random films (sha256 order over 169,476 'Category:YYYY films' members, 1915-2024) and the documented relatives outside the pool. Roles: batman_lineage (positive control and T4), relative (T3 positives), book_family (Mike Taylor's earlier book tiers that are not documented relatives), contested (excluded from the negatives and from the superhero centroid, scored and reported separately: (a) the pre-mask plot or lead names a Batman-family character, (b) a work of a T3-positive relative entity's franchise that is not a documented relative work, (c) a hero named in a relative's evidence sentence, or a relabelled lineage title), pool (negatives). stratum = genre rule on the work's own short description and first lead sentence (random films stay 'random'); stratum_category = the category-crawl stratum (sensitivity). neg_cluster = title-stem franchise cluster (entity-level null). mike_candidate = a Count of Monte Cristo work (named by the author, not documented; reported descriptively). t2n = annotated for T2-N (lineage, relatives, book family, and 40 seeded pool works from each of the random, superhero and pulp_crime strata).
